_Sprint 1: Build the Foundation — Plan_

Here are the 5 issues we'll tackle in order. Nothing assigned yet; just getting the scope clear first.

───

_Issue 1: Organizations Model + Migration_
Multi-tenancy base table. Every other record in the system scopes by `organization_id`.

• `organizations` table: `id`, `name`, `slug`, `created_at`, `updated_at`
• Unique constraint on `slug`
• Model with `$fillable` and relationships

_Issue 2: User Model with Roles_
Extends default Laravel User. Each user belongs to one organization.

• `role` enum: `admin`, `agent`, `customer`
• `organization_id` foreign key
• Model: `belongsTo(Organization::class)`
• Update default migration or create new one if needed

_Issue 3: Laravel Sanctum Auth API_
Stateless token auth for the React frontend.

• `POST /api/register` — admin creates org + user (or self-register with org)
• `POST /api/login` — email + password, returns token
• `POST /api/logout` — revoke current token
• `GET /api/user` — authenticated user data
• Proper validation, error responses, token abilities

_Issue 4: Ticket Model + Migration_
Core entity of the support desk.

• `tickets` table: `id`, `organization_id`, `subject`, `description`, `status` (enum: open, in_progress, resolved, closed), `priority` (enum: low, medium, high, urgent), `requester_id` (customer), `assignee_id` (agent, nullable), `tags` (JSON or pivot table — we'll decide during dev), `created_at`, `updated_at`
• Model with relationships: `organization`, `requester`, `assignee`

_Issue 5: Database Seeder_
Demo data for manual testing.

• 1 organization
• 1 admin user
• 2 agent users
• 2 customer users
• 12 tickets with varied status, priority, assignees, and requesters

───

_Sprint 1 Acceptance Criteria Summary_

• All migrations run clean on a fresh database
• API auth returns tokens and protects routes
• Ticket CRUD structure is in place (index/show/create routes to follow in Sprint 2)
• Seeder populates the database without errors
• Every table has `organization_id` and respects tenant scoping

Sprint plan is written to `sprints/sprint-01.md`. Here it is for the team :point_down:

---

*:building_construction: Sprint 01 — Foundation (tenancy · users · auth)*

*Goal:* Multi-tenant data foundation + working Sanctum token auth. After this sprint a user can register, log in, and get a bearer token scoped to an *organization* and a *role* (admin | agent | customer). No tickets/comments yet — that's Sprint 2.

*Status: PLANNED — nothing assigned yet.* Dependency chain is strict serial: `#1 → #2 → #3`.

*:first_place_medal: Issue #1 — Organizations model + migration *(tenant root)**
Create the `organizations` table + `Organization` model. This is the tenant anchor — every future tenant-scoped record (tickets, comments, SLA) gets an `organization_id` FK pointing here.
- Migration: `id`, `name`, `slug` (unique), `timestamps`
- Model: fillable `[name, slug]`, `hasMany(User)`
- Factory for seeding
- *Acceptance:* `php artisan migrate` creates the table cleanly; factory works.
- *Blocks:* #2, #3

*:second_place_medal: Issue #2 — Users with roles (org-scoped)*
Attach users to an org and give each a role; wire Sanctum onto the model.
- New migration `add_organization_and_role_to_users` (clean additive migration — no editing base `0001_01_01`): `organization_id` FK + `role` enum(`admin`,`agent`,`customer`)
- `App\Enums\Role` PHP enum — single source of truth
- `User` model: add `HasApiTokens`, `belongsTo(Organization)`, role cast + `isAdmin()/isAgent()/isCustomer()`
- Seeder: 1 org "Acme" + 3 demo users → `admin@/agent@/customer@acme.test` / `password`
- *Acceptance:* `php artisan migrate --seed` from a fresh clone yields the 3 demo users; matches README.
- *Depends on:* #1

*:third_place_medal: Issue #3 — Sanctum auth API (register / login / logout)*
Token-based auth endpoints. Tenant is always derived from the *authenticated user's* `organization_id` — never client-supplied.
- Create `routes/api.php` (absent today) + register in `bootstrap/app.php`
- `POST /api/register` → creates new org + its first admin (self-serve signup)
- `POST /api/login` → returns `{ token, user }` with role + org
- `POST /api/logout` → auth-guarded, deletes token
- `AuthController` + `RegisterRequest` / `LoginRequest` form requests
- *Acceptance:* register 201+token, login 200+token, logout invalidates; contract logged in `ARCHITECTURE.md`.
- *Depends on:* #1 + #2

---

*:warning: Two decisions I need before we build*
1. *DB engine:* README mandates *MySQL 8*, but `backend/.env.example` ships `DB_CONNECTION=sqlite`. Enum DDL differs per engine — we must settle the target before Issue #2. My recommendation: switch `.env.example` to MySQL to match the required stack.
2. *Registration model:* Confirm `/register` = "new org + its first admin" (agents/customers added later via admin). If you'd rather have register-into-existing-org, say so now.

---
:page_facing_up: Full plan with acceptance criteria + dependency graph committed at `sprints/sprint-01.md`.
